verdict.rationale: Chronicle's own docs say traces can be sent from an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle, so OTLP ingestion is a first-party capability. Retrieval is documented only through Timeline and the SDK, not over OTLP. missing for 10: documented OTLP endpoint details (gRPC/HTTP, URL, auth headers, semantic-convention mapping), any OTLP export or forwarding of traces out of Chronicle, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: Use SDK trace ingestion or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle.
Send them from your own code, from your agent's tool calls, or from an OpenTelemetry exporter, then query them in Timeline or through the SDK.
